lines: Automations is rebuilt: steps read as plain sentences, edits save as you go, and you can test a draft on a real past event.
Ask Vyre can build an Automation from one sentence. Its steps appear as a draft that you accept or discard.
Switching tabs no longer jumps: every place uses the same sidebar, and a place opened from a new tab takes that tab.
Getting started is shorter: connect your AI in one card, then finish setting up beside your first chat.
Rewind: go back to an earlier message in a chat with an agent, with Undo. The agent's work folder goes back too.
You can type into an agent's terminal, and on a shared agent's computer each person's folders and terminals are private.
